text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, the Trainer hears from Hishi 
Akebono that Biko Pegasus has been feeling 
down. It seems the cause is related to her 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For now, I decided to take her out for a 
change of pace and go mandarin orange 
picking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An incident occurred, but it was resolved 
smoothly thanks to Biko Pegasus's courage 
and never-give-up spirit. Hishi Akebono 
watched her with dazzling admiration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—On the way home. Hishi Akebono encourages 
Biko Pegasus, who was feeling down about 
not being able to use her small frame 
effectively and struggling to get good 
results in races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"'You're always so positive, Biko-chan. 
You're my hero.' Spurred on by those 
words, Biko Pegasus picked herself back up 
once again.
